Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator [[Richard Lugar]] was re-elected to a fourth term. Lugar won all but one county. Lugar became the first Hoosier to win a fourth full term in the U.S. Senate. == General election == ===Candidates=== *Mary Catherine Barton (New Alliance) *Barbara Bourland (Libertarian) * [[Jim
